seed_fact: If your 'Contact Us' page only has an email address, you're losing 30% of leads. Add a form.
image_headline: Your contact page is losing leads
caption:
Ever wonder why leads disappear after they click 'Contact'? If your contact page only shows an email address, most visitors will skip it—about 30% of potential customers slip away. Adding a simple contact form captures those leads instantly. DM me for a free audit of your site.
